title: Community structure of raw wastewater from a seafood processing facility
description: We examined the community structure of raw wastewater from a seafood processing facility primarily handling skipjack tuna, treated with a microalgae-bacteria consortium derived from the facility.
center: Applied Chemistry and Life Science, Toyohashi University of Technology
samples: Wastewater metagenome isolated from a seafood processing facility
Wastewater from Yaizu Fisheries Processing Center CO., LTD
environmental sample; urban association not established
